question.text: Consider the reaction equilibrium $2 \mathrm{SO}_2(\mathrm{~g})+\mathrm{O}_2(\mathrm{~g}) \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{SO}_3(\mathrm{~g}) ; \Delta \mathrm{H}^0=-198 \mathrm{~kJ}$. On the basis of Le Chatelier's principle, the condition favourable for the forward reaction is

options.text: increasing temperature as well as pressure
lowering the temperature and increasing the pressure
any value of temperature and pressure
lowering of temperature as well as pressure

solution.text:
Due to exothermicity of reaction low or optimum temperature will be required. Since 3 moles are changing to 2 moles.
$\therefore$ High pressure will be required.
